Project Ignis: EDOPro\\\\\\\\nAll assets for the game, except card images. See LICENSE and COPYING in each folder for proper credits, copyright, and rules for redistribution.\\\\\\\\nOn Windows, please do not put your game install in Program Files, Downloads, or any other location that might be read-only or require admin permissions.\\\\\\\\nOn Linux, after moving the game install to your preferred location, you can run &#96;./install.sh&#96; from a terminal to install desktop files for the current user.\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n## System requirements\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nSupported platforms:\\\\\\\\n- Windows XP Service Pack 3 or later, 32-bit or 64-bit\\\\\\\\n- macOS 10.9 or later\\\\\\\\n- 64-bit/AArch64 GNU/Linux with glibc 2.27+ (e.g. Debian 10+, Ubuntu 18.04+, Fedora, CentOS 8+, rolling release distros like Arch)\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n1 GB free disk space recommended for asset updates and images.\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n1 GB free RAM recommended, though the game is not expected to exceed 300 MB of memory during normal usage.\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n### Prerequisites for WindBot Ignite (AI):\\\\\\\\n- Windows: install .NET Framework 4 if you don't have it. This ships with Windows 10.\\\\\\\\n- Linux: install the mono-complete package https://www.mono-project.com/download/stable/#download-lin\\\\\\\\n- macOS: install Mono with the .pkg https://www.mono-project.com/download/stable/#download-mac\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n## Keyboard and mouse shortcuts\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n### General:\\\\\\\\n* ESC: Minimizes the window if not typing\\\\\\\\n* F9: Toggle topdown field view\\\\\\\\n* F10: Mac and Windows: Save the current window position (shift+F10 to restore it)\\\\\\\\n* F11: Toggles fullscreen\\\\\\\\n* F12: Captures a screenshot\\\\\\\\n* CTRL+O: Opens the additional settings window\\\\\\\\n* R: Reloads fonts if not typing\\\\\\\\n* CTRL+R: Reloads current skin\\\\\\\\n* CTRL+1: Switch to card info tab\\\\\\\\n* CTRL+2: Switch to duel log tab\\\\\\\\n* CTRL+3: Switch to chat log tab\\\\\\\\n* CTRL+4: Switch to settings tab\\\\\\\\n* CTRL+5: Switch to repositories tab\\\\\\\\n* Drag and drop support for files and text:\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\t* drop an &#96;ydk&#96; file in the main menu or the deck edit area to load that deck\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\t* drop a card passcode or card name in the deck edit area to add that card to the deck\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\t* drop a &#96;ydke://&#96; URL in the deck edit area to load the deck specified by that URL\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\t* drop a &#96;yrpX&#96; file in the main menu or the replay selection menu to load that replay, if valid\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\t* drop a Lua file in the main menu or the puzzle selection menu to load that puzzle, if valid\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\t* drop text in a text box to insert text\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\t* drop a &#96;.pem&#96;, &#96;.cer&#96;, &#96;.crt&#96; certificate bundle file to make the client use that for ssl verification (if you're getting ssl certificate is invalid)\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n### Deck editor:\\\\\\\\n* Right Mouse Button: Adds/removes a card from the deck\\\\\\\\n* Middle Mouse Button: Adds another copy of a card to the deck or side deck\\\\\\\\n* Shift+Right Mouse Button or Hold Left Mouse Button then click Right Mouse Button: Adds a card to the side deck\\\\\\\\n* With the exception of Shift+Right Mouse Button, holding Shift will ignore ALL deck building rules\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nWhile not typing:\\\\\\\\n* CTRL+C: Copies a &#96;ydke://&#96; URL of the deck list for sharing\\\\\\\\n* CTRL+SHIFT+C: Copies a plain text deck list for sharing\\\\\\\\n* CTRL+V: Imports a &#96;ydke://&#96; URL decklist from the clipboard\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n### Duel:\\\\\\\\n* Hold A or Hold Left Mouse Button: Lets the system stop at every timing.\\\\\\\\n* Hold S or Hold Right Mouse Button: Lets the system skip every timing.\\\\\\\\n* Hold D: Lets the system stop at available timing.\\\\\\\\n* F1 to F4: Shows the cards in your GY, banished, Extra Deck, Xyz Materials respectively.\\\\\\\\n* F5 to F8: Shows the cards in your opponent's GY, banished, Extra Deck, Xyz Materials respectively.\\\\\\\\n* Double click (or tap) on a card pile: Shows the cards in such pile.\\\\\\\\n* Use the Tab key to navigate between options in dialogue boxes, and press Space to select an option.\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n### macOS:\\\\\\\\nNote that system hotkeys may intercept some of the above keyboard shortcuts.\\\\\\\\nThe following app shortcuts are also available in the app and dock menus:\\\\\\\\n* Cmd+N opens a new instance with audio muted\\\\\\\\n* Cmd+Q quits the game\\\\\\\\n* Ctrl+Cmd+F toggles fullscreen\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n## Deck editor search functions\\\\\\\\n* &#96;string&#96;:\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\treturns all cards that have &#96;string&#96; in their name OR in the card text.\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\tExample: &#96;Hero&#96;\\\\\\\\n* &#96;@string&#96;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\treturns all cards that belong to the &#96;string&#96; archetype. = bot key (e.g. &#96;\\\\\\\"Zoodiac\\\\\\\"&#96;)\\\\n- Deck file = &#96;AI_\u003cdeck\u003e.ydk&#96; (with spaces removed in the filename, e.g. &#96;\\\\\\\"Toadally Awesome\\\\\\\"&#96; → &#96;AI_ToadallyAwesome.ydk&#96;)\\\\n\\\\n---\\\\n\\\\n## 3. Deck–Executor Mapping\\\\n\\\\nEDOPro passes the chosen bot’s &#96;deck&#96; value to WindBot as the deck name. WindBot then:\\\\n\\\\n1. **DecksManager** scans assemblies for classes with the &#96;[Deck]&#96; attribute.\\\\n2. Executor Pattern\\\\n\\\\nExecutors live in the WindBot source under &#96;Game/AI/Decks/&#96;. Each executor:\\\\n\\\\n### Base class\\\\n\\\\n- Inherits from &#96;DefaultExecutor&#96; (in the WindBot source).\\\\n\\\\n### Required attribute\\\\n\\\\n- &#96;[Deck(\\\\\\\"DeckName\\\\\\\", \\\\\\\"DeckFileName\\\\\\\")]&#96;\\\\n\\\\n### Typical structure\\\\n\\\\n1. **Constructor** – Registers behaviors with &#96;AddExecutor(...)&#96;.\\\\n2. **CardId** – Inner class with card IDs.\\\\n3. **Behavior methods** – Return &#96;bool&#96; for whether an action is taken.\\\\n\\\\n### Executor types\\\\n\\\\n&#96;&#96;&#96;csharp\\\\nAddExecutor(ExecutorType.Activate, cardId, customMethod);  // Activate spell/trap/monster\\\\nAddExecutor(ExecutorType.Summon, cardId, customMethod);    // Normal summon\\\\nAddExecutor(ExecutorType.SpSummon, cardId, customMethod);  // Special summon\\\\nAddExecutor(ExecutorType.MonsterSet, cardId, customMethod);  // Set monster\\\\nAddExecutor(ExecutorType.SpellSet, DefaultSpellSet);      // Set spell/trap\\\\nAddExecutor(ExecutorType.Repos, MonsterRepos);               // Reposition\\\\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\\\\n\\\\n### Common overrides\\\\n\\\\n- &#96;OnSelectHand()&#96; – Go first / second.\\\\n- &#96;OnNewTurn()&#96; – Turn reset (counters, flags).\\\\n- &#96;OnPreBattleBetween()&#96; – Battle logic.\\\\n- &#96;OnSelectAttacker()&#96; – Attack order.\\\\n- &#96;OnSelectAttackTarget()&#96; – Target selection.\\\\n- &#96;OnSelectCard()&#96;, &#96;OnSelectPosition()&#96;, &#96;OnSelectPlace()&#96; – Selections during play.\\\\n\\\\n---\\\\n\\\\n## 5. Example: BurnExecutor\\\\n\\\\nBurnExecutor is a small example:\\\\n\\\\n&#96;&#96;&#96;csharp\\\\n[Deck(\\\\\\\"Burn\\\\\\\", \\\\\\\"AI_Burn\\\\\\\", \\\\\\\"Easy\\\\\\\")]\\\\npublic class BurnExecutor : DefaultExecutor\\\\n{\\\\n    public BurnExecutor(GameAI ai, Duel duel) : base(ai, duel)\\\\n    {\\\\n        AddExecutor(ExecutorType.SpellSet, DefaultSpellSet);\\\\n        AddExecutor(ExecutorType.Activate, CardId.Ookazi);\\\\n        AddExecutor(ExecutorType.Activate, CardId.GoblinThief);\\\\n        AddExecutor(ExecutorType.SpSummon, CardId.LavaGolem, LavaGolem);\\\\n        AddExecutor(ExecutorType.MonsterSet, CardId.Marshmallon, SetInvincibleMonster);\\\\n        // ... more executors\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    private bool LavaGolem()\\\\n    {\\\\n        foreach (ClientCard card in Enemy.GetMonsters())\\\\n            if (card.Attack \u003e 2000) return true;\\\\n        return false;\\\\n    }\\\\n}\\\\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\\\\n\\\\nBehavior methods return &#96;true&#96; when the AI should take that action (e.g. summon Lava Golem only if the opponent controls a monster with \u003e2000 ATK).\\\\n\\\\n---\\\\n\\\\n## 6. Configuration\\\\n\\\\n| File                        | Role                                         |\\\\n|----------------------------|----------------------------------------------|\\\\n| &#96;WindBot/WindBot.exe.config&#96; | .NET runtime config                         |\\\\n| &#96;WindBot/bots.json&#96;       | Bot list shown by EDOPro                    |\\\\n| &#96;config/strings.conf&#96;      | UI strings, including WindBot-related text   |\\\\n| &#96;config/system.conf&#96;       | Deck size limits, deck validation options   |\\\\n\\\\n---\\\\n\\\\n## 7. Adding a New AI Executor\\\\n\\\\n1. In the **WindBot source** (ProjectIgnis/windbot):\\\\n   - Add a class: &#96;class NewDeckExecutor : DefaultExecutor&#96;\\\\n   - Add attribute: &#96;[Deck(\\\\\\\"NewDeck\\\\\\\", \\\\\\\"AI_NewDeck\\\\\\\")]&#96;\\\\n   - Register behaviors in the constructor with &#96;AddExecutor(...)&#96;.\\\\n2. In **ProjectIgnis**:\\\\n   - Add &#96;WindBot/Decks/AI_NewDeck.ydk&#96;.\\\\n   - Add an entry to &#96;WindBot/bots.json&#96; with &#96;\\\\\\\"deck\\\\\\\": \\\\\\\"NewDeck\\\\\\\"&#96;.\\\\n3. Rebuild WindBot so the new executor is compiled into &#96;WindBot.exe&#96;.\\\\n\\\\nOptional: add a &#96;Dialogs/&#96; file for custom lines for that bot.\\\\n\\\\n---\\\\n\\\\n## 8. Summary\\\\n\\\\n- &#96;bots.json&#96; drives what EDOPro shows and passes to WindBot via the &#96;deck&#96; field.\\\\n- The &#96;[Deck]&#96; attribute on each executor class links that Sí, **es totalmente posible** programar una IA de WindBot con estrategias específicas para tu deck custom. Aquí te explico cómo funciona el sistema y qué necesitarías hacer:

---

## Cómo funciona WindBot

WindBot tiene tres componentes clave que trabajan juntos:

1. **`bots.json`** — Define los bots visibles en EDOPro (nombre, deck, dificultad).
2. **`Decks/AI_*.ydk`** — El archivo de deck con los IDs de las cartas.
3. **Executor (C#)** — La clase que contiene la lógica/estrategia de la IA.

El flujo es: `bots.json` → campo `"deck"` → atributo `[Deck(...)]` en una clase C# → archivo `.ydk`.

---

## La estructura de un Executor (la IA del deck)

Cada deck tiene una clase C# llamada "Executor" que hereda de `DefaultExecutor`. Ahí defines **cuándo y cómo** la IA toma decisiones. Ejemplo simplificado:

```csharp
[Deck("MiDeckCustom", "AI_MiDeckCustom")]
public class MiDeckCustomExecutor : DefaultExecutor
{
    public class CardId
    {
        public const int MiCartaBoss = 100000001;  // ID de tu carta custom
        public const int MiCartaSpell = 100000002;
    }

    public MiDeckCustomExecutor(GameAI ai, Duel duel) : base(ai, duel)
    {
        // Registrar estrategias: cuándo activar, invocar, setear, etc.
        AddExecutor(ExecutorType.Activate, CardId.MiCartaSpell, ActivarSpellSiConviene);
        AddExecutor(ExecutorType.SpSummon, CardId.MiCartaBoss, InvocarBoss);
        AddExecutor(ExecutorType.Summon, CardId.MiCartaBoss, InvocarBossNormal);
        AddExecutor(ExecutorType.SpellSet, DefaultSpellSet);
        AddExecutor(ExecutorType.Repos, DefaultMonsterRepos);
    }

    private bool ActivarSpellSiConviene()
    {
        // Lógica: solo activar si el oponente tiene monstruos
        return Enemy.GetMonsterCount() > 0;
    }

    private bool InvocarBoss()
    {
        // Lógica: invocar especial si tengo materiales en el campo
        return Bot.GetMonsterCount() >= 2;
    }
}
```

Los tipos de acción que puedes programar incluyen:

| `ExecutorType` | Qué controla |
|---|---|
| `Activate` | Cuándo activar un efecto (monstruo, spell, trap) |
| `Summon` | Cuándo hacer invocación normal |
| `SpSummon` | Cuándo hacer invocación especial |
| `MonsterSet` | Cuándo setear un monstruo |
| `SpellSet` | Cuándo setear spells/traps |
| `Repos` | Cuándo cambiar posición de batalla |

Además puedes sobreescribir métodos como `OnSelectHand()` (ir primero/segundo), `OnNewTurn()`, `OnPreBattleBetween()`, `OnSelectCard()`, etc.

---

## Los pasos concretos para tu caso

Para crear un bot con tu deck custom, necesitarías:

### 1. Crear el archivo `.ydk`
Ya sabes hacer esto — poner los IDs de tus cartas custom en `WindBot/Decks/AI_MiDeck.ydk`.

### 2. Escribir el Executor en C#
Esto requiere clonar el **repositorio fuente de WindBot**: [github.com/ProjectIgnis/windbot](https://github.com/ProjectIgnis/windbot). Los executors están en `Game/AI/Decks/`. Creas tu archivo `.cs` con la lógica de tu deck.

### 3. Compilar WindBot
Después de escribir tu executor, recompilas el proyecto para generar el nuevo `WindBot.exe`.

### 4. Registrar el bot en `bots.json`
Agregar una entrada como:

```json
{
    "name": "Mi Deck Custom",
    "deck": "MiDeckCustom",
    "difficulty": 3,
    "masterRules": [ 5 ]
}
```

### 5. (Opcional) Agregar diálogos
Crear un archivo en `Dialogs/` con líneas personalizadas para el bot.

---

## Para grabar videos automatizados

Una vez que tengas el bot funcionando, puedes:

- Iniciar un duelo contra el bot en EDOPro normalmente
- Ambos lados pueden ser bots si configuras dos WindBot enfrentándose
- Grabar con OBS o cualquier capturadora

---

## Consideraciones importantes

- **La parte más compleja es escribir el Executor**: necesitas conocer C# y la API de WindBot (`Bot`, `Enemy`, `Card`, `ClientCard`, etc.).
- **Sin Executor**, el bot usará `DefaultExecutor`, que toma decisiones genéricas (activa todo lo que pueda, invoca lo que tenga más ATK, etc.) — funciona, pero no será estratégico.
- **Las cartas custom funcionan igual** que las oficiales en WindBot, solo necesitas usar sus IDs numéricos de la `.cdb`.

Si quieres, puedo guiarte en detalle sobre cómo escribir un Executor específico para alguno de tus decks custom — solo necesitarías cambiar a modo Agent para que pueda crear los archivos.
